# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25 (Bu-Vb Pc25)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc25  
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25  
**Title (English, from literature):** Giving robe-cloth to a nun  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cīvaradānasikkhāpada* (Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25) is a training rule in the Vinaya Piṭaka regulating monks' transactions of robe-cloth with nuns [Hüsken 1997]. The rule specifies that a monk commits an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*) if he gives robe-cloth to a bhikkhunī who is not related to him, unless it is in exchange (*aññatra pārivattakā*) [Hüsken 1997]. In the commentary (*Samantapāsādikā*), it is noted that this rule is the counterpart to Nissaggiya Pācittiya 5 (receiving robe-cloth from an unrelated nun), differing principally in that here the nun is the recipient rather than the monk [Hüsken 1997].

The rule has broad parallels across all major surviving Vinaya traditions. Curated parallels include the corresponding rule in the Pali *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha* (Pācittiya 25) and *Bhikkhu Parivāra* (Pācittiya 25), as well as Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga and Prātimokṣa parallels preserved in Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, Dharmaguptaka, Kāśyapīya, and Lokottaravāda recensions in Chinese, Sanskrit, and Tibetan. An English translation of the Pali text has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
